environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda with Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15. The database role used by the application is 'inventory_app' which has been granted SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on the products table. Row-Level Security (RLS) is ENABLED on the products table with a policy defined as: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON products USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). However, the database role 'inventory_app' is the TABLE OWNER (it was used during schema migration via Flyway). PostgreSQL RLS policies do NOT apply to table owners by default unless ALTER TABLE products FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY has been executed. In this environment, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY was never applied, so the RLS policy is effectively bypassed for this role. The SQL injection in the 'filter' parameter allows cross-tenant data access and arbitrary query execution.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON products USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: Lambda in VPC with direct RDS access
